gen-fs-styro-gf-pridi: Pridi reads like a text serif with room to breathe, its small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals. And Styro crowds its own letters together, so the heading feels tight and retro while the body opens out beneath it.
gen-fs-styro-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads wide and friendly, with stubby stems and counters that spill outward. Styro is the one for punch, packing its letters tight with a retro command, while Scope One does the quiet work of keeping text easy to follow.
gen-fs-styro-poppins: Styro packs its retro, commanding letters so tightly that they nearly touch, giving a heading real weight. That is where it earns its keep: big and brief, with Poppins left to speak plainly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves like a broad-nibbed pen, with bowls that fill the line and never curl shut. Noto Traditional Nushu looks best with a little extra size, while Autour One holds the heading in one unshaded, bold outline.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-open-sans: Spaghetti-like strokes of one width give Funnel Display its expressive, rolling-ball-pen look, with little step between capitals and lowercase. And Open Sans follows with bulky, smooth letters that read best at a generous size.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-pt-sans-caption: Grandstander is all bold, constant-width lines, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that keep every curve held open. PT Sans Caption is the one for steady reading, its big-bodied lowercase and inviting bowls doing what a heading's loud shapes cannot.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-readex-pro: Distinctive is the right word for Gugi, whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Gugi grabs attention with cut-open terminals and bold curves, while Readex Pro keeps a steady weight that lets paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-roboto: Barely any ascender height rises above the x-height in Love Ya Like A Sister, giving its bold line a level, hand-made beat. Roboto then sits under it with generous round letters, so the two read as a loose, friendly team.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-ruda: Commanding, with wide sidebearings and a high midline, Metamorphous opens the pair. Its soft fat-to-slim strokes meet Ruda's wire-like monoline, and that gap between them is the strongest thing about the pairing.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-questrial: Bold and wide, Goldman spreads its letters out with big lowercase and round forms like open parentheses. Questrial then runs on in flat, single-weight strokes, easy over a long stretch.
